findings.summary: Evidence bundle did not report data_boundary, basis and data_processing_declared, which the plan's Observability paragraph requires.
The startup-refusal case with context_assembler on cannot exist before 3b.2 adds the field; moved into 3b.2's test list by ruling.
test_committed_profiles_are_local checks check_route_boundary, not a full start; renamed or made to build the runtime.
Loopback detection is correct and fails closed; pin more bypass cases (userinfo, nip.io, trailing dot).
Scripted driver ignores a contradicting declaration; acceptable per ADR 0030, left as is.
The e2e helper edit does not weaken those tests; a comment now says the adapter's endpoint check is the backstop.
